scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Content
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays correctly with headline, subheadline, and CTAs that communicate the product value proposition

steps.description: Load the homepage at the root URL path '/'
steps.context: User arrives at the application for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section is prominently displayed above the fold
steps.context: Hero section should be the first visual element users see

steps.description: Confirm the headline clearly describes URL shortening service and subheadline explains key benefits
steps.context: REQ-1: Display prominent hero section with headline, subheadline

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' primary CTA and 'Login' secondary CTA are visible
steps.context: REQ-4: Include prominent Get Started and Login buttons

test_cases.input: Render Home component and query for hero section elements
test_cases.expected: Hero section container exists with headline, subheadline, and CTA buttons

test_cases.input: Query for headline text content
test_cases.expected: Headline contains text related to URL shortening, link tracking, or insights

test_cases.input: Query for 'Get Started' button
test_cases.expected: Primary CTA button with text 'Get Started' or 'Get Started Free' is visible

test_cases.input: Query for 'Login' link or button
test_cases.expected: Secondary CTA for login is visible and accessible

scenarios.name: Navigation and Call-to-Action Functionality
scenarios.description: Test that CTA buttons correctly navigate to registration and login pages

steps.description: Click the primary 'Get Started' CTA button in the hero section
steps.context: User wants to sign up for the service

steps.description: Confirm the application navigates to /register route
steps.context: REQ-4: Get Started should lead to registration

steps.action: Return to homepage and click Login
steps.description: Navigate back to homepage and click the Login button
Confirm the application navigates to /login route
steps.context: REQ-4: Login button should lead to login page

test_cases.input: Click 'Get Started' button and check router location
test_cases.expected: Navigation occurs to '/register' path

test_cases.input: Click 'Login' button and check router location
test_cases.expected: Navigation occurs to '/login' path

test_cases.input: Verify Get Started button has correct href or onClick handler
test_cases.expected: Button element links to /register route

test_cases.input: Verify Login button has correct href or onClick handler
test_cases.expected: Button element links to /login route

scenarios.name: Authentication State Awareness
scenarios.description: Verify that the homepage displays appropriate CTAs based on user authentication status

steps.description: Visit homepage without being logged in
steps.context: New visitor with no authentication token

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'Login' buttons are displayed
steps.context: REQ-8: Show appropriate CTAs based on login status

steps.description: Visit homepage while logged in with valid session
Check that 'Go to Dashboard' button is displayed instead of 'Get Started'
steps.context: REQ-8: Authenticated users see dashboard link

test_cases.input: Render Home with AuthContext providing isAuthenticated=false
test_cases.expected: 'Get Started' and 'Login' buttons are visible, 'Go to Dashboard' is not

test_cases.input: Render Home with AuthContext providing isAuthenticated=true
test_cases.expected: 'Go to Dashboard' button is visible, 'Get Started' is hidden or replaced

test_cases.input: Click 'Go to Dashboard' as authenticated user
test_cases.expected: Navigation occurs to '/dashboard' path

test_cases.input: Verify AuthContext consumption in Home component
test_cases.expected: Component correctly reads authentication state from context
